tb_wetness — 2D typed op

• Data kinds: rgbimage → rgbimage

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "tb_wetness", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

Usage

Base colour of a wet surface. Diffuse darkens (and specular increases).

base_rgb: colour in the dry state, (H,W,3) or (3,). wet: degree of wetness (0–1).

ior: refractive index of the water film.

Return value: diffuse colour in the wet state (same shape).

Why it darkens: total internal reflection occurs inside the water film, so diffuse light is sent back to the surface again and again and absorbed each time. As an approximation, for the dry reflectance ρ a re-absorption equivalent to the internal reflectance Ri = 1 − (1 − Ri0)/n² is applied ―― exactly the phenomenon of wet sand looking dark (the increase in specular reflection is expressed by layering clearcoat_shade(coat=wet) on top).

The optics op wetness bridged into the 2-D evolution registry. The implementation is the same; only the calling convention is adapted to op(v, a, b). a sweeps wet (default 1) and b sweeps ior (default 1.33).
